_about: What scripts/check_diver.py holds the diver's clips to, in millimetres, against PLAYER_HEIGHT and PLAYER_RADIUS read from balance.rs. allow_mm: top, how far over PLAYER_HEIGHT the figure may reach (the helmet is 13 mm over at rest, raised arms in the air); core, how far past PLAYER_RADIUS the hips, torso, head and helmet may lean; ground, how far under the feet anything may go; measured, how far an exempt clip may grow past what was measured. arm_reach_mm: the arms' reach from the upright axis (the old figure's hand was 720 mm out, with the gun past it). leg_reach_mm: a stride's reach. exempt: clips that leave the volume by design, each with why and its reach measured on 2026-11-08 from the bake of tools/mesh/src/ltc.blend.

jump.why: the take-off's arms rise past the helmet

time_stop.why: the left hand raised over the helmet to stop the moment

bounce.why: arms flung up off the shockwave

air_jump.why: a somersault about the hips: the body turns through the horizontal

land.why: a deep crouch, the torso pitched forward

hook_pull.why: hung from the hook's line, the body swung forward

pound_drop.why: knees to the chest, the body tipped into the fall

pound_land.why: the slam: the torso folded over the knees

slash.why: the torso turned into the swing

throw.why: the torso follows the throw through

swim.why: laid forward in the stroke, arms and legs reaching

death.why: lies on the floor: the body is out of play

wake.why: not drawn: the bedroom's waking is the painting waking.png
